findings.title: Development mode allows unauthenticated access
findings.description: The authentication middleware allows unauthenticated API access in development mode when API_KEY is not set. While appropriate for development, this could be a risk if development code reaches production.
findings.remediation: Ensure NODE_ENV is set to 'production' and API_KEY is configured in all production deployments

findings.title: Confirmation header uses simple string comparison
findings.description: The confirmationMiddleware uses a simple string comparison ('true') which is less secure than cryptographic verification for sensitive operations.
findings.remediation: Consider implementing a CSRF token or signed confirmation mechanism for sensitive operations

authentication_audit.details: Authentication module uses crypto.timingSafeEqual() for constant-time API key comparison, preventing timing attacks. The CVE-2024-12345 vulnerability has been properly addressed.
